english.title: Occupy a building without a certificate that it will be supplied with sufficient wholesome water
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the owner of a house at **(..SPECIFY ADDRESS..), and having been given a notice from **(..SPECIFY LOCAL AUTHORITY..) under section 25(3) of the Building Act 1984 prohibiting you from occupying it or permitting it to be occupied,

(A)_[occupied it]_
(B)_[permitted it to be occupied]_

before that authority had granted a certificate to the effect that a sufficient supply of water had been provided
english.legislation: Contrary to section 25(6) of the Building Act 1984.

other.penalty:

Note: A further fine of £2 for each day on which the offence continues after conviction.
